scope: Admin primary-Chrome replay and filter acceptance for existing Showcase JSON-LD and OG recipes on Google's public Article structured-data page. This is not whole-feature closure.

target.identity: admin@admin.com visible in the extension panel

build.chrome_source_identity: chrome://extensions showed enabled Matrx Extend, matching ID/version, and loaded-from path .output/chrome-mv3-dev
build.explicit_reload: Chrome extensions details displayed Reloaded after the explicit Reload action; the article tab was then refreshed.

resource_guard.recovery: Three healthy samples satisfied the existing unsafe-hold recovery requirement before admission.
resource_guard.watch_evidence: Every retained watch event was RESOURCE_WATCH_HEALTHY; no unsafe event or stop-at-boundary request occurred.

observations.result: Clicking the sole rendered BreadcrumbList type chip populated the filter. Clearing the field and extracting retained one row; BreadcrumbList filtering also returned the one matching block; NonexistentType showed 'No matching JSON-LD blocks.'

Blank and BreadcrumbList filters each returned one live row. The row's @type was BreadcrumbList and itemListElement contained Search Central, Documentation, and the current Article page URL. NonexistentType returned the visible no-match state.

After extension reload and public-page refresh, the existing saved JSON-LD recipe codex-structured-native-20260928-jsonld-breadcrumb was replayed from Showcase Patterns. It returned one BreadcrumbList row with the current page's breadcrumb links. No recipe was created or deleted.

After extension reload and public-page refresh, the existing saved OG snapshot recipe codex-structured-native-20260928-og-metadata was replayed and returned one row. The displayed title matched Chrome's visible article document title; OG values included Google for Developers, the Article title, current page URL, and the current social image. The replay values were not independently compared field-by-field against a separate DOM metadata read.

Navigated the same Chrome tab to the listed same-host 404 path. The JSON-LD tab displayed 'No JSON-LD on this page'. A fresh Snapshot capture returned one row with the 404 title, its current URL, current OG/Twitter image, and Google for Developers site name. This was a fresh Snapshot capture, not a replay of either saved recipe on the changed page.

limitations: No independent field-by-field DOM metadata comparison was captured for the Article page.
The changed-page check used live JSON-LD empty state and a new Snapshot capture; saved-recipe replay on the 404 page was not run.
Recipe editor reopen, draft/save variation, auth transitions, service errors, guest/member modes, metadata mutation on the same route, and whole-feature closure remain unverified.
No screenshots, credentials, tokens, or unrelated page content were retained.
commit_policy: Exact evidence paths only; do not push (CI red).
